title: The Green and Pink Christmas Dinner Table
description: A green and pink Christmas dinner table, all from Walmart: Better Homes & Gardens Brooks green stoneware, a green tree-embossed baking dish, gold River flatware, Pioneer Woman Amelia pink tumblers and two glass tree candles.
intro: Red and green is fine. It's just not the only option. This table goes sage and pink instead, and it looks like you planned it for weeks. Sage stoneware plates, a deep green baking dish with a tiny tree on the lid, gold flatware, pink glass tumblers with that vintage embossing, and two glass tree candles, one green and one raspberry. Put the roasted veggies right in the baker and call it a centerpiece. Nobody has to know.

sections.heading: The dishes
paragraphs: The Better Homes & Gardens Brooks 12-piece stoneware dinnerware set in green: four 10.2-inch dinner plates, four 8.66-inch salad plates and four 6-inch bowls, with a reactive glaze so every piece is a little different.

sections.heading: The star of the table
paragraphs: The Better Homes & Gardens 15.8-inch green embossed tree stoneware baking dish with lid. Little trees all the way around the sides and a tree knob on top. It goes from oven to table, so it's doing double duty as the centerpiece.

sections.heading: The sparkle
paragraphs: The Better Homes & Gardens River 20-piece flatware set in gold, The Pioneer Woman Amelia pink 15.22-ounce glass tumblers (set of 4), and two Better Homes & Gardens glass Christmas tree candles: the 2-wick Fresh Cut Frasier in green and the 1-wick Old Fashioned Candy Cane in pink.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, the food, the garland and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
